name: io.github.winter0x/mcp
description: Rent real NVIDIA GPUs from your agent. Browse with no wallet; pay per second onchain.

environmentVariables.name: PRISM_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent wallet private key (0x...). Only needed to lease and pay; browsing works without it

environmentVariables.name: PRISM_DAILY_BUDGET_USDG
environmentVariables.description: Most this wallet may spend through Prism in any 24 hours. Defaults to 5. Set 0 to remove the ceiling

environmentVariables.name: PRISM_MAX_USDG
environmentVariables.description: Most any single lease or generation may cost. Defaults to 1. A max_usdg argument can lower it and cannot raise it
